name: Aalto University
summary: Technology, business and design university in Espoo; 11 English bachelor's options, each admitting you to a bachelor's and a master's.

ib.text: IB applicants go in admission round B, ranked on IB grades with national scoring tables. HL and SL score the same; engineering options need advanced maths at 6. No English test needed.

dates.label: Aalto's own application opens, 08:00 Finnish time
Aalto's own application closes (not the joint application), 15:00 Finnish time
Round B (IB) results published at the latest
Final IB grades due and deadline to accept your place, 15:00

programmes.name: Design and Media
programmes.about: Visual communication, industrial and digital design studied together, crossing art, media and technology, with a Nordic, human-centred and sustainable approach to design.
programmes.ib: IB grades do not count: preliminary assignments, intake assignments and an interview decide.
programmes.selectionNote: Preliminary assignments (pass/fail) due 29 Jan 2027, 15:00; intake assignments due 31 Mar; interview 3–7 May. Scored out of 100; grades do not count.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Economic theory with a strong quantitative toolkit: data analysis, programming and econometrics, applied to real-world questions. Admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.
programmes.ib: Economics scoring table; advanced maths at 2 or basic maths at 4.

needs.note: Grade 2 in AA or AI HL; AI SL counts as basic maths and needs grade 4.

programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national economics table. 35 of the 50 places are in round B, 28 kept for first-time applicants; a few go on SAT.

programmes.name: Finance
programmes.about: Finance, analytics and strategic decision-making built on business and economics, with attention to socially responsible investment and impact beyond the financial return. New in 2027.
programmes.ib: Economics scoring table; advanced maths at 2 or basic maths at 4. SAT/ACT is an optional second route.

needs.note: Grade 2 in AA or AI HL; AI SL counts as basic maths and needs grade 4.

programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national economics table; a few round-B places go on SAT/ACT. New programme, so no past cut-off.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: Marketing, accounting, management and entrepreneurship taught through real business cases and teamwork, with data skills for evidence-based decisions, on the Otaniemi campus.
programmes.ib: Business scoring table; any maths at grade 2. SAT/ACT is an optional second route.
programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national business table; 38 round-B places on certificates and 7 on SAT/ACT, 40 more in round A.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering
programmes.about: Chemistry fundamentals with a strong base in mathematics, programming and machine learning, leading to process engineering, biotechnology and sustainable industry.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.
programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national technology table. 15 of the 35 places are in round B, 11 of them kept for first-time applicants.

programmes.name: Computer Engineering
programmes.about: Mathematics, physics and computer science with hands-on programming and electrical engineering, joining hardware and software for fields such as AI, IoT and telecoms.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.
programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national technology table. 18 of the 40 places are in round B, 13 of them kept for first-time applicants.

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.about: Mathematics, statistics and machine learning combined to extract insight from data and build predictive models, preparing you to work as a digitalisation expert.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.
programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national technology table. 11 of the 30 places are in round B, 8 of them kept for first-time applicants.

programmes.name: Digital Systems and Design
programmes.about: Electrical engineering joined with engineering design: networking, automation, programming and machine learning, plus project work with industry partners.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.
programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national technology table. 18 of the 45 places are in round B, 13 of them kept for first-time applicants.

programmes.name: Mechanical and Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Classical mechanical and civil engineering taught through computational simulation and programming, building virtual models of physical systems; leads on to Aalto master's in mechanical, civil or geoengineering.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.
programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national technology table. 18 of the 45 places are in round B, 13 of them kept for first-time applicants.

programmes.name: Quantum Technology
programmes.about: Quantum physics, mathematics, computer science and electrical engineering for computing, communication and sensing, with lab work and master's-level topics early on.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths or physics at grade 6.

needs.note: Maths must be advanced: AA at SL or HL, or AI at HL.

programmes.selectionNote: Round B: ranked on IB grades with the national technology table. 15 of the 35 places are in round B, 11 of them kept for first-time applicants.

programmes.name: Technology, Business and Design
programmes.about: A first year spent on technology, business and design together in one class (maths, programming, finance, strategy, design), then a major in one of the three. New in 2027.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths at grade 6 plus a passed preliminary assignment, published 17 December 2026.
programmes.selectionNote: Pass the preliminary assignment (published 17 Dec 2026), then you are ranked on IB grades. Places are to be announced by October 2026.

notes: Aalto runs its own application on Studyinfo, not the national joint application, so its window closes on 22 January 2027 rather than the 21st.
You can choose at most three study options in one round, and you are admitted to only one.
Every bachelor's place comes with the right to continue to a named Aalto master's, so you are admitted to a 3+2 year path.
